title: Microsoft Purview: auto-expanding archive limit rises from 1.5 TB to 3 TB for eligible mailboxes
summary: The increased archive ceiling, eligible licensing, automatic arrival and PowerShell controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The corrected per-user command now carries the required cloud-mailbox qualification. A minor checklist-to-table gap remains for monitoring archive growth.
